title: Akkadian Empire
summary: Sargon of Akkad founded the Akkadian Empire around 2334 BCE, and it is often described as the first multinational empire in the world. It brought Mesopotamia under one rule, placing its officials as governors in over 65 cities and standardizing administration, weights and measures and a postal system. It ended around 2154 BCE. How it fell remains a mystery, and its capital, Akkad, has never been found; a later Mesopotamian text blames Gutian invaders.

uncertainty.note: World History Encyclopedia gives 2350/2334–2154 BCE; Encyclopaedia Iranica dates Sargon's reign to 2334–2279 BCE.
